verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for an identity-management SaaS platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents one in Microsoft Entra ID. Lifecycle workflows are rule-based automation, not an AI assistant you delegate tasks to. The MCP probe points to a Microsoft Learn docs/training MCP server, not an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
